Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hello,
Here's a question that has been asked on another forum:

Vampire A has a Perfectionist and performs a hunt action.
Vampire B wants to play Follow the Blood.

A's action is unblocked, and no reaction cards were played before resolution (nor during resolution).

Does A gain 1 blood from Perfectionist before B plays Follow the Blood?

I'm under the impression that Perfectionist is immediately triggered after resolution of the action, before A could pass, just like there: http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad... (http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/f8efe8a155a9cc3a) (for some reason, I couldn't put that link in some nice url thingy). Therefore, A gains Perfectionist's blood, and, then, B plays Follow the Blood.
Is that correct?

Thanks,
Pascal.

~~

Follow the Blood
Cardtype: Reaction
Requires a Black Hand vampire. Only usable when a hunt action is successful, after resolution.
-{Tap}- this Black Hand vampire. -{He or she}- enters combat with the acting vampire. This reacting vampire gets an optional maneuver or press in that combat.

Perfectionist
Cardtype: Master
Master: archetype.
Put this card on a vampire you control. Once per turn, when this vampire sucessfully performs an action and no reaction cards are played, he or she gains 1 blood after the action is resolved. A vampire can have only one archetype.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson (Rulemonger)
Messages.Body:
> floppyzedolfin wrote:
> Does A gain 1 blood from Perfectionist before B plays Follow the Blood?
>
> I'm under the impression that Perfectionist is immediately triggered after resolution of the action, Therefore, A gains Perfectionist's blood, and, then, B plays Follow the Blood.
> Is that correct?
Yes.
